title: AXI-Lite Write-Only Control
constraints: `0x00` CTRL: write-only 32-bit register driving `ctrl_out` (reset 0), honoring `wstrb`. `0x04` PULSE: writing sets `pulse_out[i]` for exactly **one** `aclk` cycle for each bit i = 1 in `wdata[7:0]` (only if `wstrb[0]`).
Writes to other addresses: SLVERR (`2'b10`), no effect. **Every read** returns 0 with SLVERR.

AXI4-Lite handshake rules: a transfer happens on a rising edge where VALID and READY are both 1. Your slave must accept AW and W in **either order** (or together), must not assert BVALID before both have been accepted, nor RVALID before AR has been accepted, and must hold BVALID/RVALID and their payload stable until BREADY/RREADY. `aresetn` is an active-low synchronous reset.
hints: Latch AW and W independently into holding registers (`aw_full`, `w_full`), then perform the write once both are full and raise BVALID.
Deassert AWREADY/WREADY while holding a transaction or while BVALID is waiting, so a second write can't overwrite the first.
The read channel is independent: `arready = !rvalid`, and register RDATA/RRESP on the AR handshake.
`pulse_out` is a register that is loaded on the write and cleared on every other cycle.

examples.check: PULSE bits fire for one cycle
examples.title: pulse
examples.expected: pulse_out[0] and [2] high for one cycle
